Vibudha
śaiva. Upāgama in Sahasrāgama. See list in Kāmika.

Vibudhakaṇṭhabhūṣaṇa
or Kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇa. name of C. by Vaidikasārvabhauma [Page29-225b] Veṅkaṭanātha, son of Raṅganātha on Gṛhyaratna of his own.
See Kane, HDS I. p. 1103a.
See under the text an. also under Veṅkaṭācārya.

Vibudhcandra
teacher of Siṃhatilaka (a. of C. Vṛtti on Bhuvanadīpaka, RASB. X. ii. 7226-27).

Vibudhacandrikā
kāvya. composed in 1664 A. D. name of C. by Manorathakavi, son of Chatrapa on Nalodaya of Kālidāsa.
See. K. K. Raja, CKSL. p. 30.
Bomb.
. Rep. Raj & C. I. p. 36. RORI. II.

Vibudhadānava-samavakāra
drama. in 3 acts, dealing with the story of the marriage of Lakṣmī with Nārāyaṇa. by (pradhāna) Veṅkappaiya or Veṅkāmātya.
Mysore N. D.

. Extr. p. 345. 27817. Extr. p. 350.
See Pradhāna Veṅkappaiya poet an. playwrite in the J. of Myth. Soc. XXXI. p.. 42-43.

Vibudhaprabha
successor of Somaprabhasūri of the Nāgendra Gaccha an. [Page29-226a] preceptor of Dharmakumāra (a. of Śālibhadracaritra, BORI. D.

(inc.).
-or Jvaracikitsā. a. sn. of Śārṅgadharasaṃhitā of Śārṅgadhara. Adyar II. p. 70b (2 mss.; 1 inc.).

Vibudhabhūṣaṇa
kāvya. by Hālāsyanātha. Adyar II. p. 15a. Adyar D.

Vibudhamohana
nāṭaka. by Harijīvana Miśra. Bikaner 3200. Rep. Raj & C. I. p. 52.

Vibudharatnākara
-Nāgakumāracaritra. Rajasthan Jain Pt. V. p. 341.

Vibudharājirañjinī
name of C. by Cakradhara Jhā, son of Śatrughna of Sāgarapura on Virudāvalī of Raghudeva Sarasvatī.
Pt.. Benares, 1904.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 519. 873.

Vibudhavaryatīrtha
-Subhadrāharaṇa (with auto C.).
See BNK. Sharma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. Vol. II. p. 381.

Vibudhavallabhā
name of C. by Gopīnātha on Trivikramaśata of Trivikrama. Bikaner 4748-49.

Vibudhavimala_Sūri
pupil of Vimalakīrti of Tapāgaccha.
-Upadeśaśataka. composed in Saṃ. 1793.
of 1895-98. BORI. D. XVIII. i. 279. Jaingranthāvali p.. 173. 208 (says a. a. Vijayavimala). L. D.

. ii. 385. Peters. VI. p. 112 (no. 553).
-(Aṣṭaprakārapūjāgarbhita) Jineśvarāṣṭaka.
-Pārśvanāthastotra.
Pt.. in Jainastotraratnāvali p.. 13. 16.
-Sambhavanāthastotra.
-Siddhācalastotra.

of 1891-95.
See also under the text.
-Śrutāvatāra. See Gode P. K. SILH. p.. 58-59; also Jinaratnakośa, p.. 293b. 399a.

Vibudhānanda
name of C. by Mahādeva Sūri of Vellāla family of Bhāradvājagotra on Nīlakaṇṭhavijayacampū of Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣiṭa.
Baroda

. Extr. p.. 252-53. 27033-34. PUL. II. p. 272 (inc.).
Pt.. (1). in Grantha script, Madras, 1874. 1913. (2). in Telugu script, Madras, 1874. (3). Poona, 1878-88.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 288.

Vibudhānandaprabandha
kāvya. a ḍima, giving the description of various sacred places, such a. Śrīraṅgam etc. visited by two persons, viz. Bālapriya an. Priyamvada in the course of their journey to Badrikāśrama to attend the marriage of Śilavatī an. Makaranda, son of Kandarpa. The whole story being introduced a. the subject of a conversation between two parrots. by Veṅkaṭakavi.

Vibudhānanda_Mukunda
of Cīravāṭika village, another name of Rāmacandra Bhāratī (a. of C. on the Vṛttaratnākara of Kedāra Bhaṭṭa, Bṛ.

Vibudhānanda_Sarasvatī
disciple of Vāsudevananda Sarasvatī.
-Sandhyābhāṣya. Mysore N. D.

Vibudhendra_Āśrama
or
ºĀcārya. preceptor of Devendrāśrama (a. of Puraścaraṇacandrikā, [Page29-227b] RORI. II.

Vibudhendratīrtha
alias Kṛṣṇānubhūti Yati, disciple of Ānandānubhūti (1500-1600 A. D.).
-Adhikaraṇasaṅkhyāśloka. Adyar D.

.
See R. Thangaswami, Bibl. Adv. Lit. p. 332.
